about.title: Bridging Sudanese exporters with the world
about.subtitle: Sudan Export Platform was founded to modernise agricultural commodity trade — replacing fragmented, opaque processes with a transparent, digital B2B marketplace that works for both exporters and international buyers.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Sudan is one of Africa's largest producers of sesame seeds, gum arabic, groundnuts, hibiscus, and cotton — yet many of its exporters have lacked the tools and connections to reach premium international buyers efficiently.
mission.p2: Sudan Export Platform solves this by providing a secure, structured B2B marketplace where verified Sudanese suppliers can showcase their products, receive detailed sourcing requests, and compete for international contracts — all in one place.
mission.p3: Our platform handles the complexity of B2B trade: RFQ management, quotation comparison, document handling, supplier verification, and direct communication — so both sides can focus on what matters: the deal.

item1.title: Trust & Verification
item1.description: Every supplier and buyer on the platform is identity-verified and document-checked. We maintain strict onboarding standards to protect all parties.

item2.title: Global Reach
item2.description: We connect Sudanese agricultural exporters with buyers across 40+ countries — from Europe and North America to Asia and the Gulf.

item3.title: Fair Trade
item3.description: Our transparent RFQ system ensures competitive, market-driven pricing without hidden middlemen or opaque markups.

item4.title: Economic Growth
item4.description: We are committed to growing Sudan's agricultural export revenues by giving local producers direct access to international markets.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about trading on Sudan Export Platform.

general.title: General
general.a1: Sudan Export Platform is a B2B marketplace that connects verified Sudanese agricultural exporters and suppliers with international buyers. We facilitate transparent RFQ (Request for Quotation) workflows, secure communication, and document management for commodity trade.
general.q2: What commodities are available on the platform?
general.a2: We currently support five core Sudanese agricultural commodities: Sesame Seeds, Gum Arabic, Groundnuts (Peanuts), Hibiscus (Karkadeh), and Cotton. We are continuously expanding our product range.
general.q3: Is the platform free to use?
general.a3: Registration and browsing are free. Trading fees and subscription details are available upon registration. Contact us for enterprise pricing.

buyers.title: For Buyers
buyers.q1: How do I post a Request for Quotation (RFQ)?
buyers.a1: After registering as a buyer and completing your company profile, navigate to the Buyer Portal and click 'New RFQ'. Fill in the product details, required quantity, delivery terms, and submission deadline. Your RFQ will be visible to verified suppliers who can then submit competitive quotations.
buyers.q2: How do I compare and award quotations?
buyers.a2: Once suppliers submit quotations, you can view all responses in your RFQ detail page. The platform provides a side-by-side comparison view. When satisfied, click 'Award' on the preferred quotation. The winning supplier is notified automatically.
buyers.q3: Are suppliers on the platform verified?
buyers.a3: Yes. All suppliers must submit company registration documents and go through an admin verification process before they can submit quotations. Only verified suppliers are marked with a verified badge.
buyers.q4: Can I communicate directly with suppliers?
buyers.a4: Yes. Once you post an RFQ or receive quotations, you can message suppliers directly through the built-in messaging system in your buyer portal.

suppliers.title: For Suppliers
suppliers.q1: How do I register as a supplier?
suppliers.a1: Click 'Become a Supplier' or 'Get Started', complete the registration form, then upload your company registration documents and commodity export certificates. Our admin team will review and verify your profile, typically within 2 business days.
suppliers.q2: How do I find and bid on RFQs?
suppliers.a2: After verification, log in to your supplier portal and browse open RFQs from international buyers. Filter by commodity type, quantity, or deadline. Click any RFQ to view full details and submit a competitive quotation.
suppliers.q3: What documents do I need to register?
suppliers.a3: You'll need: company registration certificate, tax ID, export licence (where applicable), and commodity-specific certificates (e.g. phytosanitary certificates for agricultural goods). Detailed requirements are listed during registration.

platform.title: Platform & Security
platform.q1: How does the platform protect my data?
platform.a1: We use industry-standard encryption for all data in transit and at rest. Authentication is handled by Clerk, a leading identity platform. We never store payment card information and all API communications are secured with HTTPS.
platform.q2: What currencies does the platform support?
platform.a2: Quotations can be submitted in USD, EUR, GBP, and SAR. The system displays amounts in the currency chosen by the supplier. Currency conversion is not performed on-platform.
platform.a3: You can reach our support team through the Contact page, or email support@sudanexport.com. We aim to respond within one business day.
